paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Hiyya bar Yehudah, in R' Hanina's name: Jerusalem Berakhot, beginning of the first chapter, 49b; Shabbat, first chapter, end of halakhah 1; and Yevamot, He-Arel, halakhah 1. “R' Shmuel bar bar Hiyya bar Yehudah”: one bar is a scribal error. In Midrash Hazit, at “Return, return”: R' Shmuel bar Hiyya bar Yudan, in R' Hanina's name.
